name: gleap
description: Work your Gleap support queue from Codex: triage tickets, draft replies, and fix or answer tickets with your plan and progress live in Gleap.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to your Gleap workspace (EU region): triage the inbox, draft replies, and fix or answer tickets. For sessions started from Gleap, hooks mirror your plan and your last message to the Gleap coding session.
